$comment: Single source of truth for every generated asset. Consumed by tools/lib/* and tools/generate/*, and asserted by tools/check-contrast.mjs. Values are sampled from the two supplied Engineering Studio references: ink-dominant ground, ivory serif display, teal technical signal, copper editorial accent.

type.$comment: Three OFL faces. SVG served through cannot fetch webfonts, so every face is embedded as a per-asset base64 subset by tools/lib/fonts.mjs. Small descriptions inside artwork intentionally use the system sans stack to keep payloads down.

sans.stack: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

mono.stack: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

motion.$comment: One reveal per section, then stillness. Every animated asset collapses to its finished frame under prefers-reduced-motion.
